subject: Urgent: FlightLine AZ surge — exec approval for cross-region rehome
messages:
From: FlightLine Ops <ops@flightline.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-23T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate in us-west-2 AZ

Team —

We started seeing a sustained spike in 5xx and token latency at 07:45 PT in us-west-2a. Error rate jumped from 0.6% to 9% and p95 latency doubled for short-chat workloads. Impacting production traffic for FlightLine (customer id FL-71). We've already routed non-essential traffic to us-west-2b but are still seeing overload and request help. Attached: spike graph.

Amit Shah
SRE, FlightLine

Attachments: flightline_spike_graph.png (image/png, 220KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Amit Shah <amit@flightline.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate in us-west-2 AZ

Thanks Amit — we're on it. Quick status:
- Detected KV-cache hot spots and increased queue depth on us-west-2a.
- Autoscaler has attempted additional pods but latency remains high.

Plan (short):
1) Authorize cross-region rehome to us-east-1 (warm replicas available).
2) Apply temporary token-rate cap for non-essential endpoints (we'll keep critical endpoints full-rate).
3) Enable read-through cache TTL relax for 30m.

Jonas and Hannah — need exec sign-off on cross-region rehome (expected ~22-28 minute cutover). I attached proposed_rehome_plan_v1.pdf. If approved we'll schedule a rolling rehome starting +30m.

-Vanessa
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_rehome_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 580KB)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Date: 2026-09-23T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate in us-west-2 AZ

+1 on rehome. Notes:
- us-east-1 has 18% spare capacity for FL-71 sustained qps.
- We'll do a prefix-aware drain to preserve KV cache hits for hot customers.
- Routing change documented in playbook SRV-9421.

Estimate: 22 minutes to cut traffic with staged DNS + routing. I'll coordinate ops runbook and monitor.

-Hannah

- Error rate back to baseline (0.7%). p95 latency within target.
- Brief customer-facing note sent to FL Ops (see SRV-9421 comment).
